simple.meaning: בָּגוֹד (bâgôwd) is a Hebrew word meaning “treacherous.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בָּגוֹד (H901) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 3:7, with occurrences in Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּגוֹד (H901) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בָּגוֹד (H901) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בָּגוֹד (bâgôwd) / H901 is traced through Jeremiah 3:7, Jeremiah 3:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

timeline.evidenceText: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says Yahweh.
